overview: Eyes of God explores love, divinity, and survival through a surreal, non narrative lens grounded in Black faith and human fragility. Set in the contemporary South, the film searches for holiness beyond religion finding it instead in care, endurance, and creation. Through recurring images of life, death, and restoration, it honors the spiritual force embedded in Black love, revealing a quiet grace that sustains even within cycles that cannot be broken.
